arknights-skin-desc: Arknights design-system skin for PRTS.wiki — terminal (dark) / archive (light) dual theme, wikitext-driven sidebar and header navigation
arknights-config-themedefault: Default colour theme: 'os' (follow system), 'day' (archive / light) or 'night' (terminal / dark).
arknights-config-themecolor: Value of the theme-color meta tag.
arknights-config-menusidebar: Render MediaWiki:MenuSidebar (wikitext, parsed with the current page as context) as the sidebar navigation.
arknights-config-menusidebarmessage: Name of the MediaWiki-namespace message that holds the sidebar wikitext.
arknights-config-menusidebaraftermessage: Name of the MediaWiki-namespace message rendered below the sidebar. Empty string disables it.
arknights-config-menusidebarhideportlets: Hide the MediaWiki:Sidebar portlets (except toolbox and languages) when the wikitext sidebar is enabled.
arknights-config-headernavmessage: Name of the MediaWiki-namespace message rendered as the primary header navigation.
arknights-config-showpagetools: Visibility of the page tools: true, false, 'login' or 'permission-<right>'.
arknights-config-sidebarflyout: Enable hover fly-out previews of collapsed sidebar branches on desktop.
arknights-config-enablethemetoggle: Show the theme toggle in the header.
